The PKGBUILD contains only standard variable declarations (pkgname, pkgver, depends, makedepends, checkdepends, optdepends, source, sha256sums) and function definitions (build(), check(), package()). None of these define any malicious behavior such as subprocess calls, external network requests, or data exfiltration. Since no code is being executed that could compromise the system—only the initial parsing of the PKGBUILD itself—the command is safe to run.
</details>
